lines.groups.header: Color and two opacities for line groups:
lines.pathMode.info: What does the Path mode option do?
lines.randomizeColors.info: What do the Color randomization options do?
lines.anchor.info: What does the Anchor option do?
hint.randomizeRange: 0 keeps each color's original value; a larger value widens its random range. Hue has no effect on gray, whose chroma is zero, so raise Chroma range as well to change a gray's color.
hint.anchor: Original line colors draws every group from the colors the artwork defines, ignoring any color override in the link, so repeated clicks give variations of the same palette; Current line colors draws from the colors the link currently carries, so each click builds on the last and repeated clicks drift away from the original.
hint.pathMode: Relative and merged: 'stroke-opacity' applies to entire line groups. Absolute and separated: 'stroke-opacity' applies to individual lines.
render.heightPixelSize.info: How large can the Height pixel size option be?
hint.pngSize: The slider supports sizes up to 512 pixels, but you can manually enter a larger value into the box. Larger sizes will exponentially increase rendering time.
